title: ResearchMD evidence locator
description: One shape for Phase 1 manual citation plus page and Phase 3 PDF page plus box. Phase 1 writers set kind manual with citation and page; Phase 3 adds the pdf block. Readers must accept both and must never drop the pdf block.

kind.description: manual: typed or pasted citation (Phase 1). pdf: pinned to a stored PDF page (Phase 3).

citation.description: Human-readable source reference, for example FirstAuthor et al 2020 or a DOI.

page.description: Phase 1: the page as the researcher writes it (12 or 12-14). Phase 3 mirrors pdf.page.

section.description: Section heading the value came from, when known.

table.description: Table or figure label the value came from, for example Table 2.

quote.description: Exact quoted snippet supporting the value.

pdf.description: Phase 3 only; null or absent in Phase 1.

artifactId.description: research_artifacts id of the stored PDF.

box.description: Normalized bounding box of the value on the page, 0 to 1.
